chapter: The Silhouettes (aurora, levels 41-50) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#907): a haunting nyckelharpa melody in the middle register, answered by a fiddle and a cello over plucked kantele, with only a soft frame drum and a brushed snare for the pulse - no kick, no toms, no cymbals (the owner's Jukebox note, 2026-10-16: Nordic, Oud and Theatre rather too pounding, primitive and a bit unpleasant)

brief_1.caption: Wintry Nordic folk-pop instrumental: a fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a hardanger fiddle playing one singable melody together in the middle register, a low wooden flute answering it, a gentle string ensemble holding warm chords, a plucked kantele, a round acoustic bass, the percussion only a soft frame drum and a very quiet brushed snare keeping a gentle steady pulse, the melody growing a little in each section, calm, magical and mysterious like snow falling under the aurora, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, the full ensemble playing throughout from the first bar, no vocals
